verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.trychannel3.com that indexes the docs as Markdown pages (e.g. index.md, the MCP shopping-agent guide). Channel3 also publishes dedicated agent-oriented files: a developers/agents.md and an auth.md, plus .md versions of every doc page. Together these give agents clean, directly consumable entry points. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no independent user reports of agents successfully using these docs.
